text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All I showed were my shortcomings, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My arms and legs... won't move the way I 
want. The more I struggle, the more 
tangled up I seem to get...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to fix everything, every last bit. 
And I will. No matter how small of a 
detail it might be.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... I'll never reach the pinnacle 
of racing!

choice_data_list:
Everything we've done up to this point 
won't go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. There's no such thing as 
a race where you gain nothing...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"What I need to do right now. I'll find at 
least one thing to take back with me!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll write down everything about today's 
race! Please stay with me for the review 
meeting!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Let's be even hungrier for victory

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Please tell me! What do I need to do 
to win?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter how grueling the training is, 
I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because I believe the path I walk with 
you, Trainer, leads all the way to the 
peak!
